issues.legal_issue: A statutory beneficiary of compulsory land acquisition cannot privately agree to return acquired land after possession has been taken, thereby reversing the acquisition.
A statutory board cannot transfer acquired land without the required statutory sanction or return it when it has not obtained title through a conveyance from the Government.
An arbitral award enforcing an agreement that reverses a completed compulsory acquisition is contrary to the fundamental policy of Indian law and must be set aside as conflicting with public policy.
Courts reviewing an arbitral award under Sections 34 and 37 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act must set it aside when it enforces an agreement contrary to the fundamental policy of Indian law.
